name: The Long Road
notes: Undo Rush and Hint Rush: detours that used to give ten minutes of free undos or hints now give a rush you start yourself. When you're out, hold the button: two minutes of free undos (one of free hints) on a clock that only runs while you're on a job.
Colour gates show how they'll stand at the end of your plan, not where the van has got to.
The map takes no taps while the van's driving on from a win, and a chest you've earned opens before it sets off.
